I'll analyze this screenshot of the Upharma Desktop ERP application in detail to help you recreate it accurately.

## Overall Layout Structure
The application has a classic desktop ERP interface with a sidebar navigation on the left and main content area on the right. The design follows a clean, professional medical/pharmacy management system aesthetic with a teal/green color scheme.

## Header Section
- **Top bar**: Dark gray background with browser tabs and system icons
- **Application header**: White background with:
  - Left: Green circular logo with "Upharma" text
  - Center: Breadcrumb navigation showing "Upharma Medical Store" and "Settings"
  - Right: Date/time (Sat, 09 May, 2026 06:49:26 pm) and user info ("Administrator Admin")

## Left Sidebar Navigation
- **Background**: White with light gray borders
- **Items** (with icons):
  - Dashboard (grid icon)
  - POS Billing (shopping cart icon)
  - Medicines (pill icon)
  - Inventory (boxes icon)
  - Purchases (truck icon)
  - Customers (people icon)
  - Suppliers (document icon)
  - Returns (refresh icon)
  - Reports (chart icon)
  - Settings (gear icon) - currently selected
  - Backup (database icon)
- **Bottom**: "Collapse" button and version info "Upharma v1.0.0"

## Main Content Area
### Page Header
- **Title**: "Settings" with gear icon
- **Subtitle**: "Configure your pharmacy ERP settings"
- **Tabs**: Store, GST, Print, Users (selected), Invoice

### User Management Section
- **Header**: "User Management" with people icon and subtitle "Manage users, roles, and access permissions"
- **Button**: Green "Add User" button with plus icon on the right

### User Table
- **Columns**: Name, Username, Role, Status, Last Login, Actions
- **Rows**:

  2. Sneha Patil | sneha | Pharmacist (white badge) | Active (green toggle) | 2025-01-22 08:15 | Edit icon
  3. Amit Joshi | amit | Cashier (white badge) | Active (green toggle) | 2025-01-21 17:45 | Edit icon
  4. Kavita Sharma | kavita | Manager (white badge) | Active (green toggle) | 2025-01-22 10:00 | Edit icon
  5. Vikram Singh | vikram | Cashier (white badge) | Inactive (gray toggle) | 2025-01-10 14:20 | Edit icon

## Color Scheme
- **Primary**: Teal/green (#10B981 or similar)
- **Background**: White (#FFFFFF)
- **Sidebar**: White with light gray borders
- **Text**: Dark gray/black for main text, lighter gray for secondary text
- **Status indicators**: Green for active, gray for inactive
- **Badges**: Green for admin role, white with gray text for other roles

## Design Elements
- Clean, modern interface with ample white space
- Consistent icon usage throughout
- Toggle switches for status
- Table layout with clear headers
- Professional medical/pharmacy color palette
- Responsive design elements

## Additional UI Details
- System tray at bottom showing time (18:49), date (09-05-2026), battery (16%), and weather (35°C, Mostly sunny)
- Browser showing multiple tabs open
- Standard Windows taskbar at bottom

This detailed analysis should help you recreate the interface with all its specific elements, colors, and layout precisely.
